prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production sprite atlas for a warm, lightly comic lived-in Suzhou family-home game. The attached furniture atlas is a STYLE AND CAMERA reference only: matching detailed softly painted watercolor/gouache textures, warm wood, sage, faded brick-red, cream, high oblique dollhouse camera. Generate exactly SIX fully isolated objects in a strict equal 3-column by 2-row grid, 1536x1024, each object centered wholly inside its 512x512 cell with at least 35px transparent padding. TRANSPARENT background, no colored backdrop, no shared floor, no text, no people. Top-left: a large worn faded brick-red rectangular woven rug with muted cream border, frayed short fringe, high oblique floor perspective, slightly rumpled corner, no stain (stain is separate). Top-middle: irregular brown tea stain/splash for overlay on that rug, translucent wet edges, a couple of small splashes, no cup and no surrounding surface. Top-right: an amusingly overflowing untidy pile of rumpled shirts, small socks and a towel, a sock sticking up, on the floor without basket. Bottom-left: scattered colorful wooden toy blocks with a tiny half-built block tower and a toy car tipped on its side, naturally spread out on the floor. Bottom-middle: a messy stack of used porcelain rice bowls, spoons, two teacups and a small dish with crumbs, suitable to sit on a table. Bottom-right: two mismatched slippers, a small child's open schoolbag with exercise books spilling out and a loose sock. Keep full silhouettes, separated cells, readable at small game size. Mild domestic chaos, charming and funny, not dirty or dilapidated. No baked-in labels, UI, shadows extending out of cells, watermark, or grid lines.
